title: Uniform Pixel Patch
description: You are given a string representing a row of pixels, where each character is an uppercase English letter representing a color. You are allowed to perform at most k operations, where in each operation you can choose any pixel and change its color to any other uppercase English letter. Find the length of the longest contiguous segment containing all identical colors you can get after performing the allowed operations.
constraints: s consists of only uppercase English letters.
input_format: A string s and an integer k.
output_format: An integer representing the maximum length of a uniform color segment.

examples.explanation: Replace the two 'A's with 'B's or vice versa to get all 'B's or all 'A's.
Replace the one 'B' in the middle to get "A A A A B B A". The longest substring has length 4.
With k = 0, no replacements are allowed. The longest uniform substring is "AA" of length 2.
